general.name: alibaba/open-code-review
general.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
general.description_zh: 安全、快速、高效，经阿里巴巴大规模实战检验。混合架构代码审查工具：确定性 pipeline + LLM Agent，精确到行级注释，内置多语言规则集（NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入），兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic。

general.name: anthropics/claude-code
general.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
general.description_zh: Claude Code 是一款驻留在终端中的智能编码工具，能够理解你的代码库，通过自然语言命令执行日常任务、解释复杂代码、处理 git 工作流，帮助你更快地编写代码。
features: 终端内运行的 agentic 编码工具，通过自然语言命令操作代码库
自动执行常规任务、解释复杂代码并处理 git 工作流
支持终端、IDE 使用，或在 GitHub 中 @claude 触发
提供插件机制，通过自定义命令和 agents 扩展功能
内置 /bug 命令用于直接反馈问题

general.name: JustVugg/colibri
general.description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦

general.name: Tencent/WeKnora
general.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
general.description_zh: 开源 LLM 知识平台：将原始文档转化为可查询的 RAG、自主推理 agent 和自维护 Wiki。

general.name: affaan-m/ECC
general.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
general.description_zh: 智能体框架性能优化系统。为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全性及研究优先的开发能力。

general.name: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
general.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
general.description_zh: 开源插件仓库，主要面向知识工作者在 Claude Cowork 中使用
features: 针对销售、法务、财务等岗位提供 11 个开源专业 plugin
每个 plugin 集成对应职能的 skills、connectors、slash commands 和 sub-agents
支持 Slack、Notion、Jira、Snowflake 等数百种企业工具 connector
可按公司工具、术语、流程自定义，使 Claude 适配团队
兼容 Claude Cowork 与 Claude Code 双平台运行

general.name: addyosmani/agent-skills
general.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
general.description_zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的生产级工程技能。

general.name: stablyai/orca
general.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
general.description_zh: Orca 是用于操作并行 agent 集群的 ADE。用你自己的订阅运行任意 coding agent。支持桌面端、移动端和远程 runtime。

general.name: mksglu/context-mode
general.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
general.description_zh: 面向 AI 编码 agent 的上下文窗口优化。沙箱化工具输出（减少 98%），持久化会话记忆，并通过 MCP + hooks 在 17 个平台间强制路由。

general.name: home-assistant/core
general.description: 🏡 Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first.
general.description_zh: 🏡 优先本地控制与隐私的开源家庭自动化平台。

general.name: danny-avila/LibreChat
general.description: Enhanced ChatGPT Clone: Features Agents, MCP, Skills, DeepSeek, Anthropic, AWS, OpenAI, Responses API, Azure, Groq, o1, GPT-5, Mistral, OpenRouter, Vertex AI, Gemini, Artifacts, AI model switching, message search, Code Interpreter, langchain, DALL-E-3, OpenAPI Actions, Functions, Secure Multi-User Auth, Presets, open-source for self-hosting. Active
general.description_zh: 增强版 ChatGPT 克隆：支持 Agents、MCP、Skills、DeepSeek、Anthropic、AWS、OpenAI、Responses API、Azure、Groq、o1、GPT-5、Mistral、OpenRouter、Vertex AI、Gemini、Artifacts、AI 模型切换、消息搜索、Code Interpreter、langchain、DALL-E-3、OpenAPI Actions、Functions、安全多用户认证、Presets，开源可自托管。持续活跃

general.name: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
general.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
general.description_zh: 在浏览器中运行的间谍卫星模拟器，但数据是真实的。基于逼真 3D 地球的实时开源空间情报。

general.name: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
general.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
general.description_zh: 让你的 AI agent 拥有洞察整个互联网的双眼。读取并搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书——一个 CLI，零 API 费用。

general.description_zh: 用于消除文本中 AI 生成痕迹的 Agent skill

general.description_zh: 作为 SDK、IDE 扩展或 CLI 助手的自主编码 agent。

general.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
general.description_zh: Worktrunk 是用于 Git worktree 管理的 CLI，专为并行 AI agent 工作流设计
